author: Komorebi P.

central_factorization.conclusion: The registered failure is not exhausted by the entry anchor and is not merely radial blow-up. It includes projective/angular identity-loop holonomy that produces registered hard-decision exits along paths beyond the certified H=8 finite assay.

claim_boundary: two frozen eight-state D4 systems only
fresh coordinate episodes are not held-out task-family support
finite observed-state cone membership is not ambient or infinite closure
spectra describe ambient projective mechanisms, not a causal quotient certificate
deterministic controls do not define a population of words or models
long-path and matched conclusions use only the registered 64-case deterministic transversal per episode and suffixes through H=8
old 930000/931000 relation spectroscopy and continuation outcomes are exploratory design context; fresh endpoints are adaptive-developmental and nonconfirmatory

entry.interpretation: The eight native-anchor errors are confined to suffix depth zero. Both incoming recurrent routes repair all eight without a hard regression through H=8. Wrong-semantic decoys follow their actual incoming state rather than the declared label.

execution.correction_lineage: v0.3.1 bootstrap authenticated raw checkpoint bytes but aborted before its ledger and restricted checkpoint deserialization; v0.3.2 reuses its frozen scientific computation

finite_observed_cones.interpretation: Every enumerated recurrent state from histories of length 1 through 8 remained hard-correct under every suffix through H=8, with a strictly positive finite angular buffer. This is not an ambient or infinite-horizon invariant-cone certificate.

feature_matching_audit.interpretation: These are globally selected best-score exact-length controls, not fully feature-matched or exchangeable controls.

matched_controls.interpretation: The finite deterministic panel shows several cells where the relator reference dominates its identity or all nonidentity controls, and an F2/B64 identity-path hard-signature difference. It shows no cell in which one nonidentity control exceeds the reference in both checkpoints. Cross-endpoint contrasts cannot isolate path mechanism from endpoint or decoder-facet difficulty.
matched_controls.severity_semantics: Lexicographic descending in failure-case count, reveal-case count, and negative minimum target margin. Strict-error count and angular clearance are reported diagnostics but are not severity components.

design_requirements: independently trained checkpoints as statistical units
held-out task families rather than coordinate-fresh episodes

preregistered first-exit survival curves beyond B64 and H8

phase_A_confirmatory_replication.primary_target: Prospectively test whether delayed identity-loop exits generalize across many independently trained models and genuinely held-out task families before optimizing against this diagnostic.

phase_B_mechanism_intervention.primary_target: Repair F2 identity-loop angular holonomy on a declared causal or observable subspace while contracting transverse directions, then replay the unchanged diagnostic on held-out models.
success_requires: preserve entry repair and H=8 finite-cone clearance
remove or materially delay identity-loop exits on held-out models
improve arbitrary held-out identity words, not only trained relators
retain D4 task accuracy and causal intervention behavior
show that any metric does not merely hide delayed-observable directions
phase_B_mechanism_intervention.why_F2_first: F2 is the sole relation with registered exits across all four checkpoint-by-episode-half strata by 54 inserted tokens.

recommended_next_block.title: Independent Holonomy Replication, Then Quotient Repair

relations.interpretation: Repeated semantically identity words produce fresh finite-cone exits and delayed hard reveals. F2 is the only relation with exits in all four checkpoint-by-episode-half strata; repeat 27 (54 inserted tokens) is the earliest such common cell. The grouped and stepwise ray computations agree to numerical precision, so the observed angular drift is not a product-grouping artifact.

primitive_spectra.caveat: A spectral candidate is not an orbit-wise certificate. Initial states can have zero dominant left-eigenvector component, tied spectra can still have Jordan drift, and nonnormal transients can dominate finite depth.
